## Overview {#sec-overview}

Tobacco usage has been found to be linked to numerous medical diseases and conditions, ranging from lung cancer to poor oral health \[1\]. The primary objective of this project is to explore the potential association that smoking has on periodontal disease among adults. It will include tobacco use trends in Philadelphia to highlight public health awareness on. The data that will be used for this project comes from a 2011-12 NHANES database on the periodontic aspect of oral health through the R package “ForCausality”.

Dr. Kei Katsura, a Post Doc at CHOP, and Dr. Mohammad Abukar, a professor at Temple University Dental School, were both consulted to aid with identifying potential topics and the types of analyses to be done with the dataset.

Repo Link: <https://github.com/DannyTran0/BMIN5030_Final_Project>
